correctness.rationale: Automorphism averaging preserves every rim-edge lower bound and convex spectral norm, proving existence of a globally optimal invariant chain. Fourier decomposition reduces spectral radius to three absolute affine eigenvalues. The proof balances the rim endpoints q0=2(1-p)/(a+b), proves the negative radial branch never binds (including boundary m=4), minimizes over p<=min(1/m,1-2tau), and derives switches tau1, tau2, tau3 and parity-dependent fourth regime. Independently solved corresponding 3-variable LP using SciPy HiGHS for 6 rim sizes and 9 threshold samples (54 comparisons), matched analytic SLEM; source verifier has 1833 floating and 48 rational LP cases, but proof is universal.
residual_risks: Invariant optimizer uniqueness only, not uniqueness among all asymmetric feasible matrices.
Finite LPs cannot prove unbounded m and real continuum tau; analytical minimax supplies that.
